#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add tags to Jekyll blog posts based on filename substring matching."""

import os
import re

POSTS_DIR = "/Users/binaryloader/Desktop/repository/binaryloader/blog/_posts"

# Mapping: filename substring -> list of tags to add
TAG_MAPPING = {
    # Synology
    "synology-vpn-server-setup": ["NAS", "Network"],
    "photostation-apply-custom-domain": ["NAS", "Nginx", "Domain"],
    "ssl-certificate-manual-renew": ["NAS", "Let's Encrypt", "SSH"],

    "setting-asus-router-enable-https": ["Network", "Security"],

    "generating-ssh-keys": ["Terminal"],
    "setting-open-vscode-by-command-line": ["Terminal", "Shell"],

    "install-zsh-ailen-theme": ["Terminal", "Zsh", "Shell", "Theme"],
    "install-zsh-autosuggestions": ["Terminal", "Zsh", "Shell", "Plugin"],

    "xcode12-build-ios15": ["iOS 15", "Xcode 12"],

    "ios-13-view-controller-modal": ["iOS 13", "Swift"],

    "install-cocoapods": ["iOS", "Ruby", "Package Management"],

    "2021-10-16-install-fastlane": ["iOS", "Automation", "Ruby"],

    "2021-10-20-create-fastlane-action": ["iOS", "Automation", "Ruby"],
    "2021-10-20-create-fastlane-plugin": ["iOS", "Automation", "Ruby", "RubyGems"],
    "fastlane-skip-update-check": ["iOS", "Automation"],

    # Spring
    "recklessly-spring": ["Java", "Maven", "Gradle", "Eclipse"],

    "study-resource-collections": ["iOS", "Learning Resource"],

    "loop-statements": ["Loop", "Control Flow"],
    "branch-statements": ["Branch", "Control Flow"],
    "class-instance-method": ["OOP", "Class", "Method"],

    # Ruby
    "install-homebrew": ["macOS"],
    "install-ruby": ["rbenv", "Version Management"],

    # Jekyll
    "jekyll-serve-specific-ip": ["CLI", "Server"],
    "minimal-mistakes-change-word-break": ["CSS", "Responsive"],

    # Git
    "install-git-lfs": ["Homebrew", "LFS"],
    "setting-multiple-ssh-key": ["SSH Config"],

    # Mathematics
    "prime-number-and-composition": ["Prime Number", "Number Theory"],
}


def find_matching_files\(substring\):
    """Find all .md files across ko/, en/, ja/ that contain the substring in filename."""
    all_files = []
    for lang in ["ko", "en", "ja"]:
        lang_dir = os.path.join\(POSTS_DIR, lang\)
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk\(lang_dir\):
            for f in files:
                if f.endswith\(".md"\) and substring in f:
                    all_files.append\(os.path.join\(root, f\)\)
    return sorted\(all_files\)


def add_tags_to_file\(filepath, new_tags\):
    """Add new tags to a file's YAML front matter, avoiding duplicates."""
    with open\(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8"\) as f:
        content = f.read\(\)

    # Split into front matter and body
    parts = content.split\("---", 2\)
    if len\(parts\) < 3:
        print\(f"  WARNING: Could not parse front matter in {filepath}"\)
        return False

    front_matter = parts[1]
    body = parts[2]

    # Find the tags: section
    tags_match = re.search\(r"^tags:\\s*\\n\(\(?:  - .+\\n\)*\)", front_matter, re.MULTILINE\)
    if not tags_match:
        print\(f"  WARNING: No tags: section found in {filepath}"\)
        return False

    # Extract existing tag values
    tags_block = tags_match.group\(1\)
    tag_pattern = re.compile\(r"^  - \(.+\)$", re.MULTILINE\)
    existing_tags = []
    for m in tag_pattern.finditer\(tags_block\):
        existing_tags.append\(m.group\(1\)\)

    # Filter out tags that already exist
    tags_to_add = [t for t in new_tags if t not in existing_tags]

    if not tags_to_add:
        print\(f"  SKIP \(all tags already exist\): {filepath}"\)
        return True

    # Build new tag lines
    new_tag_lines = "".join\(f"  - {t}\\n" for t in tags_to_add\)

    # Insert new tags at the end of the tags block
    tags_end = tags_match.end\(\)
    new_front_matter = front_matter[:tags_end] + new_tag_lines + front_matter[tags_end:]

    # Reconstruct the file
    new_content = "---" + new_front_matter + "---" + body

    with open\(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8"\) as f:
        f.write\(new_content\)

    print\(f"  UPDATED: {filepath} \(added: {tags_to_add}\)"\)
    return True


def main\(\):
    total_updated = 0
    total_not_found = 0

    for substring, tags in TAG_MAPPING.items\(\):
        files = find_matching_files\(substring\)
        if not files:
            print\(f"\\nNO FILES FOUND for substring: '{substring}'"\)
            total_not_found += 1
            continue

        print\(f"\\nProcessing '{substring}' -> adding tags: {tags}"\)
        print\(f"  Found {len\(files\)} file\(s\)"\)

        for f in files:
            result = add_tags_to_file\(f, tags\)
            if result:
                total_updated += 1

    print\(f"\\n{'='*60}"\)
    print\(f"Summary: {total_updated} files processed, {total_not_found} substrings with no matches"\)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main\(\)
PYEOF)
